trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Pure-data table (extracted from rem:term6-binding-density); ten trap categories n/a. Read and checked: shell labels are correct - 4He (2,2), 16O (8,8), 40Ca (20,20), 56Ni (28,28) are all doubly magic; 32S (16,16) is labelled only 'near-exact', consistent. FLAGS for the report: the seven residuals in MeV carry no witness path, no q_0 pin and no AME reference, so none is reproducible from the block; and 4He is reported as a '+2.62 magic outlier' while the other three doubly-magic entries are 'on trend', which is an honest but unexplained split.
